gloss: to store, to obtain, to pay

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}を{収|おさ}めた。
{税金|ぜいきん}を{収|おさ}める。
カメラを{鞄|かばん}に{収|おさ}めた。
examples.english: I put the camera away in my bag.

notes:
おさめる has different kanji for different meanings.

KANJI VARIATIONS:
- {収|おさ}める: to store, obtain, achieve
- {納|おさ}める: to pay, deliver, dedicate
- {治|おさ}める: to govern, rule
- {修|おさ}める: to study, master

EXPRESSIONS:
- {成功|せいこう}を{収|おさ}める: to achieve success
- {勝利|しょうり}を{収|おさ}める: to win victory
